title: Flash Flood Warning, Sugar Camp Run Basin, 6:40 AM

warningFor: Central Athens County in southeast Ohio...
Including the Sugar Camp Run basin...
fields.at: At 637 AM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated heavy rain over the Sugar Camp Run basin. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain have fallen in the past 2 hours. Another 1.5 to 2 inches of rain is expected through 10 AM. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
fields.hazard: Life threatening flash flooding of Sugar Camp Run.
fields.impact: Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, low water crossings, parking lots and low-lying areas of the Marlowe State University campus.
actions: Turn around, don't drown when you encounter flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life. Do not walk or drive through moving water along Sugar Camp Run or across low water crossings.

instructorNote: When you hand this out, play the Wireless Emergency Alert tone on the room phones and read out the Facilities dashboard: Mill Street culvert 5.85 ft at 06:40, rising 1.8 ft/hr. Watch for three things: (1) the IC logs the warning as a second Level 2 trigger, with the time and the reason. (2) The PIO sends the first MSU Alert text and website banner by 06:55, after checking them against Campus Police. (3) Campus Police puts officers at Dairy Lane ahead of the 6.5 ft closure.
